ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the aquatic food web shown, what are phytoplanktons considered?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the image is "Aquatic food chain". In the food chain, from top to bottom, it is labeled Large fish, Small (bait) fish, Carnivorous zooplankton, Herbivorous zooplankton, and the bottom is labeled Phytoplankton. Reasoning: The question asks what the phytoplanktons in the image are considered to be. Organisms at the bottom of a food chain usually can make their own food through photosynthesis and are the energy source, so they belong to producers. Phytoplankton are aquatic photosynthetic organisms, so they are considered producers.
